candidate.title: Mosaic-Seq
candidate.scope: The assigned Mosaic-Seq poster row: guide-associated enhancer perturbation and puromycin enrichment followed by the embedded Drop-Seq capture/library component and joint single-cell transcriptome/guide readout. CROP-Seq text above, Act-Seq below, and the chemical structures at right belong to neighboring poster content. Drop-Seq is a named component, not an alternative target. The left single-cell/CRISPR/polyA-RNA icon is an explanatory overview rather than a preparative RNA branch. The architecture is resolved at schematic level. Primary-paper content evidence is limited to the supplied abstracts; publication metadata identifies papers but does not verify unshown chemistry or reaction order. The gRNA-labeled library fraction is therefore retained as guide-associated cDNA, without asserting direct capture of mature guide RNA.
